positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Led fullstack development for an AI-powered notes app used by a16z, Salesforce, Dropbox, PWC, and Databricks.
Joined as engineer #2 and employee #5 as the startup scaled to 20+ staff with $29.1M in funding.
Increased user retention by 10% by serving as the principal product engineer designing, developing, and
deploying a data import service used to migrate 30M+ records from Notion, Evernote, Obsidian, etc.
Built and implemented the data upload user interface with React, Node, MobX, Emotion, Virtualized, and GCP.
Developed and deployed a stable, scalable data import API using GraphQL, GCP, PostgreSQL, and Temporal.
Migrated legacy backend architecture and data from a REST API on GCP to a GraphQL server and PostgreSQL to
increase query efficiency, create a seamless developer experience, and improve maintainability.
Accelerated development velocity by automating GraphQL updates to streamline query generation for clients.
methods, developing monitoring software to measure A/B tests, and enabling data-driven iteration.
Architected a search service for 200M documents (5-10 TB) using Elasticsearch, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and GCP.
Streamlined document search from 1400ms to 200ms by implementing query optimization and a caching layer.
Enabled in-application collaboration and document sharing by building and implementing a contact
administration platform and data processing layer to generate 9M user contacts based on user emails.
Designed, developed, and implemented a fullstack application for SMS data ingestion using Twilio, Telegram API,
Gmail API, and GCP Cloud Scheduler to enable notetaking on the go without access to the application.
Acted as the technical SME, gathering client feedback and conducting user tests to improve the product.
Streamlined development by implementing auto-generating GraphQL schemas for new queries/mutations.
Owned all data infrastructure documentation, including for email ingestion of emails into Mem.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineering Immersive Resident
positions.description:
After graduating from Hack Reactor, I was invited back as a full-time employee of the program for the next cohort cycle (February-May 2021).

In this role, I'm thrilled to be able to mentor students and revisit the material I learned! I staff our virtual help desk to assist students 1:1 on current sprints and projects, hold office hours, and facilitate check-ins and workshops, offering technical guidance and instruction on JS, CS fundamentals and full-stack web development.

volunteerExperiences.description: A very heart warming experience.  Lots of physical labor in exchange for thanks from the locals.
